### Bible Pathway - April 23
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-april-23-2013.html
Passage: 1 Kings 7:51
Points:
- Solomon finished constructing the temple and faithfully deposited the treasures dedicated by David.
- Although the precious items were in his possession, Solomon recognized that they belonged to the Lord.
- Believers often withhold their time, finances, and personal desires instead of surrendering them to God.
- True Christian discipleship requires submitting all areas of life to Christ as both Savior and Lord.

### Furnishings for the Temple
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/furnishings-for-the-temple
Passage: 1 Kings 7:48
Points:
- Solomon oversaw the careful crafting of the golden furnishings and utensils used in temple worship.
- God uniquely gifted artisans with skill and understanding to build the holy tools and structures.
- The Holy Spirit similarly grants diverse gifts to all believers for ministry in the church today.
- Practical services like maintenance, nursery care, and audiovisual support are vital for corporate worship.
